# Brains Super Speciality Hospital

> Brains Super Speciality Hospital (Bangalore, India) is a tertiary healthcare center specializing in neurosurgery, neurology, spine care, and multidisciplinary super-speciality medical services.

## Core Specialities & Centers of Excellence

- [Neurosurgery](https://brainshospital.com/Neurosurgery.html): Minimally invasive neurosurgery, brain tumor surgery, skull base and cerebrovascular surgical care.
- [Brain Tumor Treatment](https://brainshospital.com/brain-tumor-treatment-bangalore.html): Comprehensive diagnosis, surgical excision, and multimodal management of brain tumors in adults and children.
- [Spine Care & Surgery](https://brainshospital.com/spine-care-and-ortho-care-hospital-bangalore.html): Minimally invasive spine surgery, spinal decompression, correction, and spine rehabilitation.
- [Epilepsy Treatment](https://brainshospital.com/Epilepsy-Treatment.html): Diagnostic evaluation, EEG/video EEG monitoring, medical management, and surgical options for seizure disorders.
- [Stroke & Brain Attack Clinic](https://brainshospital.com/stroke-brain-attack-clinic.html): Emergency stroke intervention, comprehensive acute neuro-care, and stroke rehabilitation.
- [Critical Care Hospital](https://brainshospital.com/Critical-care-hospital-bangalore.html): 24/7 dedicated medical, surgical, and neuro-intensive critical care units (ICU).
- [Heart Care (Cardiology)](https://brainshospital.com/Heart-Care.html): Comprehensive cardiac diagnostics, heart disease management, and emergency cardiology care.
- [General Medicine](https://brainshospital.com/General-Medicine.html): Preventive health checkups, chronic disease management (diabetes, hypertension), and internal medicine.
- [Vascular Surgery & Care](https://brainshospital.com/Vascular-Care.html): Treatment for peripheral vascular disease, varicose veins, and complex vascular disorders.
- [Orthopaedic Care & Joint Replacement](https://brainshospital.com/joint-and-bone-care-hospital.html): Advanced joint replacement, bone fracture management, and arthritis care.
- [Lung Care & Pulmonology](https://brainshospital.com/Lung-Care.html): Management of asthma, pneumonia, chronic respiratory diseases, and pulmonary medicine.

## Patient Services & Contact Information

- [Emergency Services](https://brainshospital.com/Emergency-and-Trauma-Care.html): 24/7 emergency & trauma care located at 192, T Mariyappa Road, Siddapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011.
- [Book an Appointment](https://app.brainshospital.com): Online patient appointment scheduling portal.
- [International Patients](https://brainshospital.com/INTERNATIONAL-PATIENTS.html): Assistance, medical visa guidance, and specialized care for international visitors.
